title: chard detect output
description: What `chard detect <check>` prints on success: a replay of every reading a report publishes for the check (`kind: replay`), or one decoder run over one set of facts (`kind: detection`). A detection is not a verdict, since no control triple ran. `src/detect.rs` states the mechanism, and `tests/schema_conformance.rs` holds live output to this file.

language.description: The predicate language, for a predicate decoder.

sha256.description: The report's `decoders.predicates[CHECK].sha256` when `source` is `report`; this binary's decoder digest, as `chard probes` publishes it, when `source` is `corpus`.

digest_agrees.description: Whether the published predicate's canonical form has the digest it is published under. `false` exits 1.

reads.description: Each read the evaluation made, keyed `macros.NAME`, `elf.FIELD`, `elf.watched_symbols.NAME`, `elf.watched_symbols` or `elf.truncations`, with the value it returned; `null` is undefined.

chard_schema.description: The major version of this document's shape. When it moves is the CLI contract's rule (`chard --help`; DESIGN.md, "The command-line contract"): a key chard adds is not a change, which is why every object here admits one.

arm.description: The one reading site `--arm` restricted the replay to.

observations.description: The report's observations of the check. A report with none is refused through the error envelope rather than replayed at `expected: 0`.

expected.description: Readings the report owes for the check: the measured build of every observation that reached its decoder, every control arm with an outcome, and any site that publishes a `decoded`. Always `replayed` plus the length of `not_replayable`.

reason.description: `reading-absent` is a site that owes a reading and publishes none, and exits 1; the others are readings no replay can reach. A code decoder is replayed through this binary over the records its site publishes, and `code-decoder` names what remains: an arm of a check whose decoder reads an artifact the store does not keep (`detect::READS_UNSTORED_ARTIFACT`); a record that does not read, or an artifact key the store does not resolve, is refused as unusable input. `record-cut` is a record an excerpt budget cut.

key.description: The key the Published view stopped at, for `unkept-c-int-follow`.

facts_key.description: The store key of the facts the reading was evaluated over; on a code decoder's replay, the site's artifact, and empty where its build names none.

clause.description: The re-evaluation's clause; `null` where it stopped at `incomplete`, and on the replay of a code decoder, which has no clause.

incomplete.description: The key the report's facts do not hold. Such a reading disagrees.

published.description: The reading as the report states it. A code decoder's site publishes no reading, so on its replay `clause` is `code-decoder` and `outcome` and `level` are what the site states beside it: an arm's `outcome`, or the measured `verdict` and `level`.

restated.description: Each value the report states beside a published reading, held to what the reading licenses: a control arm's `outcome` against its reading's outcome, and a measured `on`, `off` or `partial` and its `level`, whether or not the observation carries a `gating`, against the verdict and level the measured reading gives on the check's scale; also each reading's `facts` and `macros` keys against the digests its own site's record publishes, and a measured `on`, `off` or `partial` against the control triple published beside it (`controls`), which earns a measurement when its positive arm is `present`, its negative arm `absent`, any regime arm `absent` and `discriminating` is true. `controls` is restated on every check, a code decoder's included, and an `outcome` or `verdict` beside a reading listed in `not_replayable` restates to `null` and disagrees. A regime arm is owed where the check's declaration in this binary's corpus asks for one and the report's `profile` adds a flag, and an owed arm that is unpublished or states no `outcome` withholds; and a `probe-invalid` beside a published triple is restated against it too, disagreeing where the triple discriminated. `indeterminate`, `unsupported` and `not-applicable` are not restated against the triple: beside a discriminating one they are what a gating rule or the fortify ratchet leaves, and a replay re-derives neither. Any entry with `agrees: false` exits 1.

field.description: `outcome` on a control arm, `verdict` on the measured build against its reading, `controls` on the measured build against its triple, and `facts` or `macros` on any site, a reading's key against the digest its record publishes.

stated.description: The arm's `outcome` (`null` where it states none), the measured `verdict` (for `verdict` and `controls`), or the reading's key (`null` where it names none).

stated_level.description: The measured `level` stated beside the verdict.

restated.description: The reading's outcome, or the verdict it licenses (`null` where it licenses no measured verdict, and where the reading was not replayed); for `controls`, the stated verdict where the triple earned it, `probe-invalid` where a triple is published and did not, `null` where none is and beside a `probe-invalid` whose triple discriminated; for `facts` and `macros`, the key the site's record binds the member to, `null` where it binds no single key.

chard_schema.description: The major version of this document's shape. When it moves is the CLI contract's rule (`chard --help`; DESIGN.md, "The command-line contract"): a key chard adds is not a change, which is why every object here admits one.

facts_key.description: The SHA-256 of the artifact, the key its facts have in a report's store.

proof.description: Whether a predicate evaluation stands behind the detection: `false` for a code decoder, and for a predicate the facts could not answer.

agrees.description: Whether the detection reproduces the record's `expected` and `expected_level`. `false` exits 1.
